item.title: 対中半導体規制巡りラトニック長官に批判、エヌビディアＣＥＯ辞任で波紋
item.description:
David Shepardson
[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - 多くの米議員の間で、ラトニック米商務長官に対する批判が強まっている。トランプ政権が数十社の中国企業を米国の主要な貿易ブラックリストに追加するのを拒んでいることや、政府がエヌビディアの対中輸出を適切に監督していたかどうかが問題視されている。

ラトニック氏の対応に対する批判は、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が１２日に辞任する前から出ていたが、フアン氏の行動を巡る波紋が広がるにつれ、ラトニック氏が対中ＡＩ半導体の入手に対する規制に十分な措置を講じてこなかったという非難が高まっている。

マサチューセッツ州選出のウォーレン上院議員（民主党）は「ラトニック商務長官とジェフリー・ケスラー商務次官は、なぜ輸出規制の抜け穴をふさいでこなかったのかを説明し、われわれの先端技術が中国の軍事力を強化することのないよう、きょう直ちに行動を起こさなければならない」と主張した。

フアン氏は、両党の対中強硬派が中国による同技術へのアクセスを規制すべきだと絶えず批判する中、対中輸出の拡大を支持してきた。

ホワイトハウス当局者は、トランプ大統領は「同長官とその職務遂行能力に全幅の信頼を寄せている」と述べた。商務省は直ちにコメントしなかった。

米メディアのアクシオスは１１日、複数の高官の話として、ラトニック長官がエヌビディア製チップを中国へ横流しした疑いのある企業に対するトランプ大統領の取り締まりに歯止めをかけていたと報じていた。

item.description: [１２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１２日、米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
トランプ氏、エヌビディア次期トップにアップルのクック氏推奨 1:16 配信

アップルのティム・クック前ＣＥＯ（左）とエヌビディアのジェンスン・フアンＣＥＯ。5月14日、北京で撮影。REUTERS/Go Nakamura/Pool（ロイター） [１２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１２日、米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の辞任のニュースを受け、アップルのティム・クック前ＣＥＯがフアン氏の後任にふさわしいとの考えを示した。

トランプ大統領は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に「素晴らしい仕事をしてきたエヌビディアのジェンセン・フアンＣＥＯが辞任した今、後任にふさわしい人物はただ一人、アップルのティム・クック氏だ」と投稿。「伝説が伝説に代わる！」と述べた。

クック氏は９月、１５年間にわたりアップルＣＥＯを務めた後に退任し、現在はアップルの執行会長を務めている。

エヌビディアはこの日、フアンＣＥＯが辞任すると発表した。フアン氏を巡っては、中国のスパイとの疑惑が持たれている女性や、社内幹部との不倫行為が取り沙汰されていた。

ロイター 関連リンク コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず アングル：アップル初の折り畳みｉＰｈｏｎｅ、強気価格が突きつける「誰のためのスマホか」 アングル：クック氏からターナス氏へ、アップル新体制にＡＩと「脱中国」の試練 焦点：ＡＩ時代のアップル、過去の「強み」は足かせとなるか コラム：クック氏退任のアップル、ＡＩ時代でｉＰｈｏｎｅ依存脱却なるか 11/13(金) 1:16 最終更新 ロイター

Nov 12 : SpaceX said on Thursday it plans to invest more than $74 billion in two supercomputing campuses, its Starbase site in Texas and in Cochise County, Arizona, expanding its AI computing ambitions alongside rocket and satellite businesses. The AI segment of the Elon Musk-led company, which went public in June, generated more than half of its revenue in the third quarter, highlighting how far the business has moved beyond rockets and Starlink satellite internet. SpaceX expects to spend more than $24 billion on the Starbase site and roughly $50 billion on the Arizona campus, it said in a statement. The Arizona campus, which needs approval from Cochise County, would create about 5,500 construction jobs and 1,000 permanent jobs.

SpaceX said it was working with local electric cooperatives and the project could cut bills for cooperative members by up to 20 per cent. It said the campus would use dry cooling, with no planned industrial groundwater use. The facility, however, faces some opposition. A petition with 2,400 signatures has asked officials to deny the permit, and a county public hearing is set for December. The Starbase facility would generate its own electricity rather than draw from the public grid. A city notice this week showed plans for a gas-fired power plant and supercomputing facility on about 444 acres. The Starbase City Commission is due to consider a property tax abatement for the project on December 9. SpaceX said the Texas project had generated more than 3,000 construction jobs and would support more than 500 permanent jobs once operational.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Nov 12 : US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that former Apple Inc Chief Executive Tim Cook should replace Jensen Huang as the CEO of Nvidia. "NOW THAT Nvidia CEO JENSEN HUANG, who has done a fantastic job, has resigned, there is only one man to take his place - TIM COOK of Apple," Trump said on social media. "A Legend replaces a Legend!" he added. Cook stepped down after a 15-year stint as Apple's CEO in September and is now executive chairman at the iPhone-maker. Apple and Cook did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

Last year, Cook presented Trump with a custom US-made plaque mounted on a 24-carat gold stand commemorating Apple's "American Manufacturing Program", after saying it would invest an additional $100 billion in domestic manufacturing. Huang resigned as CEO and a member of the board on Thursday after reports said he had an affair with a Chinese businesswoman whom US authorities suspect of spying for Beijing. Nvidia has announced that Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO. Trump, who has maintained close ties with top US tech executives in his second term, said on Monday that he had spoken to Huang and the CEO told him that he did not know the woman linked to him was allegedly a spy. Huang is one of Trump's closest allies in Silicon Valley, and the relationship between the two dates to at least 2025. Over the past two years, Huang has repeatedly voiced support for the administration's agenda and become a regular presence in Washington as Nvidia sought to sell advanced chips to the Chinese market.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米国、ＡＩによる雇用市場の「深刻な短期的混乱」に備えを＝バーＦＲＢ理事
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のバー理事は１２日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国、ＡＩによる雇用市場の「深刻な短期的混乱」に備えを＝バーＦＲＢ理事 0:52 配信

写真はバーＦＲＢ理事。4月14日、米ワシントンで撮影。REUTERS/Evan Vucci（ロイター） Howard Schneider

[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] -  米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のバー理事は１２日、人工知能（ＡＩ）によって雇用市場に「深刻な短期的混乱」が生じるリスクに米国は備えるべきだとの見解を示した。ＡＩの普及速度によっては、労働者が大規模に職を失い、投資家に有利な形で格差が拡大する可能性があるとした。

バー氏はイエール大学での講演原稿で、一部セクターでＡＩが労働の代替となっている兆候がみられており、変化が急速に進めば「大きな混乱が生じる可能性がある」と述べた。一方、ＡＩ企業間の競争により、この技術への幅広いアクセスが可能となっているため、これまでのところ労働者の解雇はほとんど起きていないと述べた。

その上で、ＡＩの影響については依然として不透明だと指摘。その帰結は、ＡＩ企業間の競争が今後も続き、この強力な新技術がインターネットが時間の経過とともにそうであったように「安価かつ広く普及したコモディティー（商品）となり、その恩恵が広く共有される」ようになるかどうかに大きくかかっていると述べた。

バー氏はまた、労働所得の割合が低下していると指摘した上で、ＡＩが資本収益率をさらに押し上げるかどうかは未解明の問題だと述べた。

バー氏の発言は、ＡＩの影響を予測するものではなく、ＡＩがもたらす社会的な緊張への備えを提言するものだ。また、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が任命した作業部会（タスクフォース）が、この新たな技術が経済に及ぼす影響を検討するために１６日にサンフランシスコで開く公開討論会を控える中での発言となった。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：中国「独身の日」、ＡＩが買い物主導　消費喚起なるかは未知数 焦点：ＡＩ信奉の誤算、米メタ　大規模リストラ縮小し「人間中心」に回帰 アングル：米雇用統計、利下げ観測復活の試金石に　ＦＲＢはなお慎重 アングル：3月米雇用統計、ＦＲＢの金利据え置きシナリオの補強要因に 焦点：ＡＩが10万人以上の雇用に影響か、米映画業界でリスキリング活況 11/13(金) 0:52 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: ＮＹ建物倒壊の死者8人に、消防士含む17人負傷＝市長
item.description:
Maria Tsvetkova Steve Gorman
[ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Maria Tsvetkova　Steve Gorman

[ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター] - 米ニューヨーク市のマムダニ市長は１２日、同市ブルックリンで１１日に倒壊したアパートの死者が８人になったと発表した。また、捜索活動に当たっていた消防士３人を含む少なくとも１７人が負傷したと明らかにした。

市消防局によると、ブルックリンのフラットブッシュ地区にある３階建ての建物は現地時間１１日午後４時（日本時間１２日午前６時）ごろ倒壊した。１９３０年築の集合住宅で、掘削工事が行われていた隣接地の建設現場に崩れ落ちた。原因は調査中。また、倒壊時に何人が在宅していたかは現時点で分かっていない。

地元メディアは、倒壊から約２時間半後、妊婦を含む少なくとも４人ががれきの下から救出されたと報じた。

市消防局長は、確認されている被害者に子ども７人が含まれるとした一方、死者が子どもか大人かについては明言を避けた。

item.description: ［ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター］ - １２日序盤の米国株式市場では、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株が大幅に下落した。米半導体大...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場・序盤＝ＡＩ関連株急落、エヌビディアＣＥＯ辞任で資金供給懸念 0:30 配信

2018年1月7日、米国ネバダ州ラスベガスで撮影。エヌビディアのジェンセン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）　REUTERS/Rick Wilking/File Photo（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　１２日　ロイター］ - １２日序盤の米国株式市場では、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株が大幅に下落した。米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の辞任を受け、資金調達や規制への懸念ですでに動揺していたＡＩ業界に新たなリスクが浮上した。

ＡＩ産業の中核を担う同社は、自社の半導体を使ったインフラ整備に資金を供給している。この戦略には資金の循環を巡って厳しい目が向けられている。

エヌビディア株は一時１２％超下落し、時価総額は５０００億ドル超が消失する勢いとなった。その後は下げ幅を縮小し、約７．５％安で推移した。

セミス・トレーディングのパートナー兼株式取引共同責任者、ジョー・サルッツィ氏は「エヌビディアは『ＡＩの銀行』と呼ばれてきた。今回の事態で資金供給から一歩引かざるを得なくなれば、資金を必要とする小規模企業への供給が途絶えるのか。答えはまだ分からない」と述べた。

エヌビディアが出資する「ネオクラウド」企業のコアウィーブは９．１％下落した。他のネオクラウド銘柄では、ＩＲＥＮやアプライド・デジタルも下落。ネビウスは、２０２６年の売上高が従来予想レンジの下限になるとの見通しを示し、１６．２％下落した。

フィラデルフィア半導体指数は１．３％下落した。

フアン氏が６月に「次の時価総額１兆ドル企業」と呼んだマーベル・テクノロジーは３．８％下落。エヌビディアとのクラウド向けＡＩ半導体取引を拡大している大規模クラウド事業者のオラクルは２．６％安となった。

メモリー半導体メーカーのマイクロン・テクノロジーは２．５％下落。データストレージ企業のサンディスクとウエスタン・デジタルはそれぞれ６％、３．７％下落した。光関連製品メーカーのルメンタムとコヒレント、ＡＩサーバーメーカーのデルは３─５．１％下落した。

建設機械・発電設備メーカーのキャタピラーと電力会社ビストラは、それぞれ約０．５％下落した。

一方、ＡＩ半導体を手掛け、エヌビディアと競合するＡＭＤとブロードコムは、それぞれ３．７％、５．６％上昇した。エヌビディアの混乱が競合他社に商機をもたらすとの期待が支えた。

他の大規模クラウド事業者では、アルファベット、アマゾン・ドット・コム、マイクロソフトも０．８─２．７％上昇した。

item.title: トランプ氏、メキシコに関税倍増を警告 移民の流入阻止しなければ
item.description:
Bo Erickson Susan Heavey
[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bo Erickson　Susan Heavey

[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１２日、先週の米中間選挙後に１０００人超の移民が米国を目指して北上しているとし、メキシコがこれを阻止しなければ同国への関税を倍増させるとし、移民の入国は認めないと警告した。

トランプ氏はソーシャルメディアへの投稿で「また始まった！」とし、「彼ら（移民）は受け入れられない！メキシコは今すぐ彼らを止めなければならない。そうしなければ、メキシコへの関税を直ちに倍増させる。メキシコ、テキサス州知事、テキサス州の非常にリベラルな新知事、わが偉大な国境警備隊、そして米移民・税関捜査局（ＩＣＥ）にはその旨を通知済みだ。一切容赦はしない！」と強調した。

米中間選挙での民主党勝利を受け、米国の移民政策がより寛容になるかもしれないとの期待を背景に、１０００人を超える移民が１１日、メキシコ南部を集団で北上。チアパス州政府筋によると、この集団は多くの家族連れを含む約１５００人規模とみられる。

メキシコ政府当局者からは、直ちには反応がなかった。

CELOUSD MiniPay's Link by Stripe integration is scheduled for 12 Nov 2026. Users in the EU and US can buy stablecoins in one click, then save, spend and send them on Celo. The integration adds a fiat onramp to MiniPay's existing base of more than 20 million wallets. It gives those users a direct route from fiat money to stablecoins for payments on Celo, supporting payment activity and visibility for the CELO token.

item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
「小幅で段階的な」米利上げ必要、インフレ抑制へ＝クリーブランド連銀総裁 11/12 23:58 配信

米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁。2025年4月24日、ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Mike Segar（ロイター） Michael S. Derby

[ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は１２日、インフレ抑制には短期金利の引き上げが依然として必要であるとの見解を示した。この発言は、１２月初旬に開かれる連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での０．５％ポイントの利上げに反対する慎重な姿勢を示唆するものとみられる。

ハマック総裁はオハイオ州立大学での講演で、「インフレ率を目標の２％に回帰させるには、金融政策を引き締め的なスタンスに転換する必要があるとみている」と指摘。来月のＦＯＭＣで０．５％ポイントの利上げが行われる可能性について、同氏は「私の見解では、小幅な利上げをより頻繁に、段階的に進める方が、企業や家計にとって対応しやすい」との見方を示した。

またハマック氏は、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は二つの責務のうち雇用面では非常にうまくやっている一方、インフレ面で数年にわたり目標を達成できていないと指摘。「直近のインフレ指標は物価上昇圧力の広がりを示している」とした上で、高インフレの一因として実需圧力を指摘した。

さらに、ＦＲＢが後手に回っているとは考えておらず、もしそうなればより積極的な対応を検討するとの考えも示した。

FAST

HYDERABAD, Nov 12 : US retailer Costco sees room to expand its technology presence in India beyond Hyderabad as it accelerates international growth, with its first global capability centre playing a key role in artificial intelligence and cybersecurity, a top executive said. The Hyderabad centre, which employs more than 70 people, supports global operations and is expected to grow to several hundred staff over the next five to six years, Javier Polit, Costco's chief information and digital officer, told Reuters on Thursday. He did not give a specific hiring target. "We're going to grow our business internationally at a greater velocity than we have been in the past. So there'll be more presence in this geography for sure," Polit said, adding that India was already playing a key role in the retailer's growth plans.  AI has delivered productivity gains of up to 60 per cent in some technology projects, Polit said, prompting Costco to build more tools in India for global deployment, including a Hyderabad-developed geofencing tool that identifies customers approaching stores to speed check-in and checkout.

The Hyderabad centre will also support data and analytics, business software and digital advertising operations, Polit said. Over time, Costco expects the mix of its technology workforce to shift to about 75 per cent employees and 25 per cent contractors, from roughly an even split today, as it builds more in-house engineering and technology capabilities, Polit said. Costco set up its Hyderabad GCC with support from consulting firm ANSR, a move Reuters reported last year could eventually employ about 1,000 people. Global capability centres, once used mainly by multinationals to cut costs, now drive higher-value work in areas such as technology, finance, product development and research. Costco, one of the world's largest retailers, operates a membership-only warehouse club business across North America, Europe and Asia. The company has built a loyal customer base through its low-price, bulk-buying model and has continued to expand globally amid resilient consumer demand.

Source: Reuters

item.title: トランプ氏、バンス氏の民主党都市の汚職対策に期待 「イランとの合意不要」
item.description: [ワシントン １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１２日、民主党が首長を務める都市における犯罪や汚職にバンス副大統領が「全精力を注ぐ」ことを望むとの考えを示した。その上で、その取り組みはイランとの合意よりも多くの資金を節約できる可能性があると述べた。

トランプ氏はソーシャルメディアへの投稿で「こうした大規模な犯罪行為を是正すれば、われわれの予算はすぐに均衡するだろう。汚職は民主党指導部の血に流れている」と指摘。「われわれにイランとの合意は必要ない。そうした時代はとうに過ぎ去った。われわれは彼らの資金、数千億ドルを押さえており、（ホルムズ）海峡も掌握している！」と述べた。

対イラン紛争の解決に向けて尽力してきたバンス氏は１１月４日、共和党が中間選挙で民主党に大敗したことを受け、トランプ氏が進めた対イラン戦争と距離を置く姿勢を示した。バンス氏は、その意義に疑問を呈するとともに、民主党に議会支配を許した有権者の厳しい審判は全面的にイラン戦争に原因があったとの認識を示し、過去に戦争終結を勧告したことについても「妥当な助言だった」と述べた。

バンス氏は２０２８年の大統領選で有力候補と目されている。

item.description: [１２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアは１２日、ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が辞任し、コレット...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
〔情報ＢＯＸ〕エヌビディア暫定ＣＥＯ、クレス氏の横顔 11/12 23:28 配信

エヌビディアは１２日、フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が辞任し、コレット・クレス最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ、写真）が暫定ＣＥＯに就くと発表した。　Nvidia/Handout via REUTERS（ロイター） [１２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアは１２日、ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が辞任し、コレット・クレス最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）が暫定ＣＥＯに就くと発表した。以下はクレス氏の横顔。

＜２０１３年からＣＦＯ＞クレス氏は２０１３年９月に執行副社長兼ＣＦＯとしてエヌビディアに入社し、以来この職を務めてきた。四半期決算説明会ではフアン氏とともに登壇してきた。同社の売上高は、クレス氏が入社した会計年度には４１億３０００万ドルだったが、２０２６会計年度には２１５９億ドルに達した。

＜エヌビディア以前の経歴＞エヌビディアに入る前、クレス氏はテキサス・インスツルメンツで８年間財務関連の職を務め、その後１９９７年から２０１０年までマイクロソフトに勤務した。マイクロソフトでは２００６年にサーバー・ツール部門のＣＦＯに就き、同部門の財務戦略、計画、報告を担当した。

２０１０年にはシスコに移り、ビジネステクノロジー・オペレーションズ財務部門の上級副社長兼ＣＦＯとして、財務戦略と事業開発を担当した。その後、２０１３年にエヌビディアへ移った。

＜学歴＞米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）に提出されたエヌビディアの年次報告書によると、クレス氏はアリゾナ大学で金融学の学士号を、サザンメソジスト大学で経営学修士（ＭＢＡ）を取得している。

フォーチュン誌が２０２４年に報じたところでは、クレス氏は大手テクノロジー企業で約２５年間財務関連の職を務めた後にエヌビディアに入社した。同氏はフォーチュン誌に対し、２０１３年に入社した当時、エヌビディアはそれまで働いた中で最も小さな会社だったと語った。

＜契約条件＞会社の委任状によると、エヌビディアの執行役員は特定の雇用期間を定めない任意雇用で、個別の雇用契約、退職金契約、支配権変更に伴う契約は結んでいない。エヌビディアは過去の提出書類で、同業他社の多くはこうした契約を提供していると説明していた。

規制当局への提出書類によると、クレス氏の報酬には譲渡制限付き株式ユニット（ＲＳＵ）が含まれ、その中には４年間かけて権利が確定する２０２６年３月付与分がある。

＜資産＞フォーブス誌は、自力で財をなした米国女性に関する２０２６年版ランキングで、クレス氏を３２位に位置付けている。同氏が保有するエヌビディア株式の評価額は１１日終値時点で約７億５０００万ドルとなり、株価が１０月にピークを付けた際の１０億ドル超から減少した。

WASHINGTON, Nov 12 : The Republican chair of the Senate Intelligence Committee urged US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to bar Chinese memory chip producer CXMT from the US market and deny it access to American technologies. Warby Parker bets on Google AI glasses for growth, but privacy fears still loom

Warby Parker Intelligent Eyewear glasses are displayed during an event in New York City, US, November 9, 2026. REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 12 : Warby Parker is entering the smart glasses market in partnership with Google and Samsung, betting that demand for the artificial intelligence wearables will balloon in the coming years. But the New York-based fashion brand, known for its affordable eyewear, is also seeking to head off privacy concerns that have weighed on existing producers of the glasses, most of which embed small cameras allowing wearers to record their surroundings without taking out their phone. The Warby Parker glasses are broadly similar to Meta smart glasses already available from Ray-Ban and Oakley maker EssilorLuxottica, which have faced regulatory scrutiny from Norway to Australia. Also like the Meta glasses, they will connect to an AI assistant, in this case Google's Gemini, for everything from directions to language translation.   The big difference from existing versions on the market is the privacy framework embedded in the glasses from the outset, Warby Parker Co-CEO Neil Blumenthal told Reuters.

Alphabet's Google will not use visuals captured with the glasses to train its AI. The glasses will bar facial recognition of bystanders. And a small white notification light on the front of the glasses automatically turns on when a user starts recording video. Shoppers will start placing pre-orders from Warby Parker on Thursday. Ray-Ban's Meta glasses still dominate, representing 81.3 per cent of AI glasses shipments in the first half of this year, according to tech research group Omdia. But brands from Warby Parker to luxury group Kering — poised to release glasses also in partnership with Google — are looking to gain a foothold. Global AI glasses shipments more than doubled in the first half of 2026 from a year ago, though growth has slowed since the second half of last year, Omdia data shows. Meta's AI glasses also include a camera notification light on the front, a Meta spokesperson said, adding that input from safety experts helped inform the privacy features on its glasses. CATEGORY CONFRONTS PRIVACY RISKS Optimism that Warby Parker's "intelligent eyewear" plan will prove to be a major growth engine has helped its shares rally by nearly 40 per cent this year, outperforming a 10 per cent gain in the S&P 500. The company expects an addition of several percentage points to fourth-quarter revenue growth from the new wearable technology, executives said on an earnings call earlier this month. "As long as the tools provide utility to customers, then we'll be successful," Blumenthal said. While the core optical backdrop remains soft, smart glasses are poised to be an "increasingly important driver" of Warby Parker's growth outlook, analysts at TD Cowen wrote in a research note last week.  Still, concerns about privacy could slow their pace of growth. One of Britain's biggest pub chains has restricted the use of the frames, Norway's government is planning a temporary ban on the use of AI glasses in certain locations, and Australia is considering barring the use of camera-equipped smart glasses in government workplaces. GOOGLE AIMS TO REBUILD TRUST Juston Payne, who leads extended reality products at Google, acknowledged that public skepticism could be a risk to growth. "This is an area where, understandably, trust was lost," he told Reuters at a demo for the Warby Parker glasses in New York. Google says it will embed extensive privacy guardrails into the devices to prevent tampering with the recording indicator light; redact people's faces from video footage before it is sent to Gemini; and ban targeted advertising on the glasses. "We are going to change this conversation," Payne said. "We are trying to raise the bar." But it remains to be seen whether those measures will ease concern about widespread surveillance, if the glasses become ubiquitous. "I'm certainly happy to hear that (video footage is) not automatically fed into AI systems for training," said Calli Schroeder, who leads the AI and human rights program at the Electronic Privacy Information Center, an advocacy group. "But that still leaves open: a stranger has footage of my kid on their phone. That's concerning no matter how you phrase it."

Source: Reuters

item.description: [ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１２日発表した１１月７日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米新規失業保険申請9000件増の20万件、労働市場なお底堅く推移 11/12 23:11 配信

2025年8月1日、米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスで撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） [ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１２日発表した１１月７日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比９０００件増の２０万件となった。増加したものの、労働市場の底堅さと整合する水準にとどまった。 ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は１９万５０００件だった。

申請件数は９月中旬以降、２０万件以下で推移しており、７月中旬に付けた１９６９年以来の低水準である１８万９０００件に近い水準を維持していることから、労働市場が逼迫しつつある可能性が高まっている。

賃金の伸びが緩やかなことから、一部のエコノミストは労働市場が再び逼迫しているとは見ていない。一方、退職の増加やトランプ大統領政権による移民取り締まり強化を背景とした労働力人口の縮小が、歴史的な低水準の申請件数の主な要因だとする見方もある。

シティグループのエコノミスト、ベロニカ・クラーク氏は「労働力人口の全般的な縮小は、失業保険を申請する労働者の数が減っていることを意味する可能性がある」と指摘。「もちろん、これは依然として低い失業率と整合性がある。継続受給件数の推移を見ると、２０２７年初頭までのデータで失業率が４．０％付近に向けてさらに低下する可能性さえ示唆されている」と述べた。

１０月３１日までの１週間の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は２万件減の１６９万７０００件だった。ただ、継続受給件数には、新卒者や就労歴がほとんどない、あるいは全くない人々など、一部の失業者は含まれていない。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：米財政運営巡る政治対立リスク、民主党勝利で市場が注目 焦点：ＡＩ信奉の誤算、米メタ　大規模リストラ縮小し「人間中心」に回帰 アングル：米雇用統計、利下げ観測復活の試金石に　ＦＲＢはなお慎重 アングル：3月米雇用統計、ＦＲＢの金利据え置きシナリオの補強要因に 焦点：ＡＩが10万人以上の雇用に影響か、米映画業界でリスキリング活況 11/12(木) 23:11 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: エヌビディアのフアンＣＥＯ辞任、ＡＩ業界に影響も 暫定トップにＣＦＯ
item.description: [１２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアは１２日、ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が辞任すると発表し...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
エヌビディアのフアンＣＥＯ辞任、ＡＩ業界に影響も　暫定トップにＣＦＯ 11/12 23:01 配信

エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアンCEO。7月16日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Manami Yamada/File Photo（ロイター） [１２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアは１２日、ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が辞任すると発表した。フアン氏を巡っては、中国のスパイとみられている女性や、社内幹部との不倫行為が取り沙汰されていた。

人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームの主要な原動力の一つであるエヌビディア率いるフアン氏の辞任によって、ＡＩ業界は最も影響力のある推進者の一人を失うことになる。フアン氏が中国市場へのアクセス維持に尽力してきたことや、トランプ米大統領との緊密な関係を踏まえると、同氏の辞任は米国の半導体輸出政策や、より広範なＡＩエコシステムにも影響を及ぼす可能性がある。

また、同氏が時価総額約４兆ドル企業へと育て上げたエヌビディアの後継者を巡る憶測も広がっている。

エヌビディアは後任ＣＥＯの選定に着手し、社内外から候補者を検討するとした。後任選びを進める間、コレット・クレス最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）が暫定ＣＥＯを務める。

投資家やアナリストの間では、フアン氏辞任前すでに、クレス氏と同社のベテランエンジニアであるイアン・バック氏が社内の有力後継候補として浮上していた。

米株式市場では、エヌビディア株は一時約１２％急落し、相場全体の重しとなった。その後は下げ幅を縮小し、約５％安で推移した。アナリストは、押し目買いが入ったことで下げ渋っていると指摘。それでも時価総額は約２０００億ドル減少する見通しだ。

競合のアドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（ＡＭＤ）とブロードコムはそれぞれ約６％上昇した。

クレス暫定ＣＥＯは従業員向けのメモで、「取締役会、経営陣、そして私自身、極めて困難な時期にあると認識している」と述べた上で、エヌビディアが米太平洋時間１８日午前９時（日本時間１９日午前２時）に会議を開催すると明らかにした。

ＣＮＢＣによると、クレス氏は同日中にも経営陣を招集する見通し。また、フアン氏は今月下旬の米感謝祭前に議会で証言することに同意したという。

フアン氏はＣＥＯに加え、社長および取締役も辞任する。同氏はエヌビディアの共同創業者で、約３．６１％の株式を保有する第４位の株主でもある。

また、同社取締役で米半導体設計大手シノプシスの元ＣＥＯであるハービー・ジョーンズ氏が、同社初の取締役会会長に就任する。

クリアブリッジ・インベストメンツのポートフォリオマネジャー、マイケル・フェルドマン氏は「リスクは、エヌビディアが突然技術ロードマップを失うことではない。ロードマップは今後数年間、おおむね見通すことができる。リスクは実行力だ。フアン氏は極めて複雑なシステムのけん引役だった」と述べた。

トランプ大統領は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に「素晴らしい仕事をしてきたエヌビディアのジェンセン・フアンＣＥＯが辞任した今、後任にふさわしい人物はただ一人、アップルのティム・クック氏だ」と投稿。「伝説が伝説に代わる！」と述べた。

フアン氏を巡っては、シンガポール企業メガスピード元幹部の中国人実業家アリス・フアン氏との不倫疑惑が浮上。米情報機関は同氏について、中国企業へのエヌビディア製半導体の流通を手助けしていたとみている。その後、フアン氏が直属の部下でヘルスケア部門担当バイスプレジデントのキンバリー・パウエル氏とも不倫関係にあったと報じられたことを受け、エヌビディアの取締役会は１１日に会合を開き、同氏の解任を検討していた。

また、情報筋２人の情報によると、フアン氏は別の従業員とも親密な関係にあったという。

フアン氏の辞任は、トランプ政権内にも波紋が及ぶ可能性がある。関係者２人はロイターに対し、ホワイトハウス高官らが、ラトニック商務長官を解任すべきかどうか協議していると明らかにした。ラトニック長官を巡っては、トランプ政権が数十社の中国企業を米国の主要な貿易ブラックリストに追加するのを拒んできたとして、議員から批判が強まっていた。

また、ジョンソン下院議長は、「フアン氏の後任に適切な人物が選ばれることが極めて重要だ」とし、中国への半導体輸出制限について、議会内で合意が形成されつつあるとの認識を示した。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：中国「独身の日」、ＡＩが買い物主導　消費喚起なるかは未知数 アングル：米債券市場、ＡＩ関連債への熱冷める　政策瀬踏みムードに アングル：「フアン氏の代わりはいない」、ＡＩ業界　最大級の擁護者失うリスク アングル：巧妙化するサイバー攻撃、攻撃する側もされる側も「ＡＩ武装」 アングル：世界市場は既にぜい弱、ＡＩにもひび割れ 11/13(金) 5:10 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down
item.description: Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO. Jensen Huang, who co-founded Nvidia, will not remain on the board.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid deepening scandal, leaving AI chip giant at crossroads

Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO. Jensen Huang, who co-founded Nvidia, will not remain on the board.

NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang looks on during the NVIDIA GTC global AI conference in San Jose, California, US, Mar 17, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Carlos Barria)

12 Nov 2026 10:01PM (Updated: 13 Nov 2026 04:01AM)

FAST

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stepped down on Thursday (Nov 12) after revelations of two extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy, plunged the chipmaker into crisis and sent shockwaves across an AI industry he helped bankroll. Huang's exit caps a tumultuous week for Nvidia , one of the major engines behind the AI boom, and could have far-reaching consequences for US chip export policy and the broader AI ecosystem, given the ex-CEO's push to preserve access to the Chinese market, as well as his close ties with US President Donald Trump. The crisis has threatened to implicate some Trump administration members, including Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, who is facing growing questions over the administration's oversight of chip sales to China, particularly as both he and Huang pushed for relaxing those sales despite scrutiny from longtime China hawks in both parties. The Commerce Department did not immediately comment. Senior White House officials are discussing whether Lutnick should be pushed out, two people familiar with the situation told Reuters on Thursday.

The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Lutnick's future. Earlier in the day, a White House official said US President Donald Trump "maintains complete confidence in the secretary and his ability to carry out the position." Huang's departure threatens to disrupt an AI ecosystem that he helped shape by pouring Nvidia 's swelling cash pile back into cloud providers, suppliers and the industry's biggest labs. The surge in AI computing demand drove a sevenfold increase in Nvidia 's shares through early October, pushing its market value at one point to nearly $6 trillion. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO as Nvidia looks for a permanent successor, considering both internal and external candidates, the company said on Thursday.

Related:

Who would be next CEO at Nvidia? Top engineer and CFO favoured as candidates

Jensen Huang scandal could spur tighter US scrutiny of AI cloud providers in Southeast Asia: Analysts

The departure has also ignited speculation over who will ultimately lead the company, long associated with the leather-jacket-wearing Huang, who co-founded Nvidia more than three decades ago. Kress and longtime Nvidia engineer Ian Buck had emerged as the leading internal candidates among investors and analysts even before Huang's departure. Nvidia shares were down about 4.8 per cent, paring earlier losses. Shares of rivals AMD and Broadcom rose about 6 per cent each. Huang, Nvidia 's fourth-largest shareholder with a 3.61 per cent stake, will also leave the board. Nvidia named former Synopsys CEO and longtime director Harvey Jones as its first board chair. "The Board, Estaff (executive staff) and I recognize that this has been an extraordinarily difficult period," Kress wrote in a memo to employees, adding that the company will host a meeting on Nov 18. Kress was gathering Nvidia 's executive team at its headquarters on Thursday, CNBC reported, adding that Huang had agreed to testify before Congress before Thanksgiving. Huang has hired law firm Paul Weiss, the New York Times reported, citing two people familiar with the matter. It was not clear what the firm had been retained to do, the report said. The company has not commented beyond its statement announcing Huang's resignation. REPLACING HUANG Pressure had been mounting on Huang in recent days after reports said the 63-year-old, who is married, had an affair with a Chinese businesswoman whom US authorities suspect of spying for Beijing. The New York Times also reported Wednesday that Huang had an extramarital affair with a senior company executive who reported to him. While Kress offers investors a familiar hand after 13 years as CFO, analysts have pointed to Buck as a potential longer-term candidate because of Nvidia 's reliance on technical leadership. The veteran engineer helped develop its crucial CUDA software platform and now leads its hyperscale AI products. "The risk is not that Nvidia suddenly loses its technology roadmap ... that roadmap is largely visible for the next several years. The risk is execution. Jensen has been the chief conductor of an extraordinarily complex system," said Michael Feldman, portfolio manager at ClearBridge Investments. "In a world with real bottlenecks, that coordination is a competitive advantage in itself." Investor sentiment toward AI stocks has already been shaky as soaring cash burn and rising debt at traditionally cash-rich tech giants fuel doubts over whether the AI boom will pay off.

TRUMP WEIGHS IN Trump said on Sunday that Huang had "done an amazing job for our country" and that the Nvidia chief had told him he had no idea the Chinese woman he had an affair with was a spy. On Thursday, the US president suggested former Apple CEO Tim Cook should take over as Nvidia 's CEO. US House Speaker Mike Johnson said it was "critically important for right successor to be chosen to replace Huang," noting there was a growing consensus in Congress on limiting exports of semiconductor chips to China. HUANG'S ROCK-STAR STATUS For years, Nvidia was best known to gamers chasing top-tier graphics. But its chips' ability to perform many calculations at once has made them the oil of the AI boom and a strategic prize in the US-China race to dominate the technology. It also made Nvidia the world's most valuable company. That turned Huang into a rock-star CEO, mobbed by fans in Taiwan and South Korea who ask him to sign books, posters and sometimes even their bodies. The scandal preceding Huang's departure unfolded over more than a year, beginning with an October 2025 New York Times report linking him to Alice Huang , a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed, a coveted official Nvidia cloud partner with priority access to its chips. Subsequent reports said US intelligence officials believed Alice Huang was acting on behalf of Chinese intelligence. Beijing has denied Alice Huang is a spy. Washington has also investigated Megaspeed over suspicions it helped China obtain advanced AI chips restricted under US export controls, according to media reports.

Related:

Alice Huang barred from re-entering Singapore; insufficient evidence she committed offences in Megaspeed probe: MHA

What we know about Megaspeed, Singapore-based customer of Nvidia

Separately, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday that the US Justice Department was investigating Alice Huang over whether entities linked to her were involved in efforts to smuggle Super Micro Computer products to China, citing a person familiar with the matter. A spokesperson for the Manhattan US Attorney’s office declined to comment on the Bloomberg report. The office previously charged three people associated with Super Micro, including its co-founder, with helping smuggle at least US$2.5 billion of US AI technology to China in violation of export laws. Super Micro did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Earlier, the Singapore Ministry of Home Affairs said Singapore police had been investigating Super Micro as part of a wider probe into Megaspeed and Alice Huang. The police had reached out to the FBI and the Justice Department for help and had received "limited information or assistance," the ministry said. Earlier this month, Nvidia 's board launched a probe, led by independent directors with outside legal counsel, into whether Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence operation. It also expressed confidence in him at the time. The controversy escalated on Wednesday when the New York Times reported Huang also had an affair with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia 's vice president of healthcare, who reported to him.

Source: Reuters/sz/fs

item.description: Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO. Jensen Huang, who co-founded Nvidia, will not remain on the board.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid deepening scandal, leaving AI chip giant at crossroads

Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO. Jensen Huang, who co-founded Nvidia, will not remain on the board.

NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang looks on during the NVIDIA GTC global AI conference in San Jose, California, US, Mar 17, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Carlos Barria)

12 Nov 2026 10:01PM (Updated: 13 Nov 2026 04:01AM)

FAST

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stepped down on Thursday (Nov 12) after revelations of two extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy, plunged the chipmaker into crisis and sent shockwaves across an AI industry he helped bankroll. Huang's exit caps a tumultuous week for Nvidia , one of the major engines behind the AI boom, and could have far-reaching consequences for US chip export policy and the broader AI ecosystem, given the ex-CEO's push to preserve access to the Chinese market, as well as his close ties with US President Donald Trump. The crisis has threatened to implicate some Trump administration members, including Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, who is facing growing questions over the administration's oversight of chip sales to China, particularly as both he and Huang pushed for relaxing those sales despite scrutiny from longtime China hawks in both parties. The Commerce Department did not immediately comment. Senior White House officials are discussing whether Lutnick should be pushed out, two people familiar with the situation told Reuters on Thursday.

The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Lutnick's future. Earlier in the day, a White House official said US President Donald Trump "maintains complete confidence in the secretary and his ability to carry out the position." Huang's departure threatens to disrupt an AI ecosystem that he helped shape by pouring Nvidia 's swelling cash pile back into cloud providers, suppliers and the industry's biggest labs. The surge in AI computing demand drove a sevenfold increase in Nvidia 's shares through early October, pushing its market value at one point to nearly $6 trillion. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO as Nvidia looks for a permanent successor, considering both internal and external candidates, the company said on Thursday.

Related:

Who would be next CEO at Nvidia? Top engineer and CFO favoured as candidates

Jensen Huang scandal could spur tighter US scrutiny of AI cloud providers in Southeast Asia: Analysts

The departure has also ignited speculation over who will ultimately lead the company, long associated with the leather-jacket-wearing Huang, who co-founded Nvidia more than three decades ago. Kress and longtime Nvidia engineer Ian Buck had emerged as the leading internal candidates among investors and analysts even before Huang's departure. Nvidia shares were down about 4.8 per cent, paring earlier losses. Shares of rivals AMD and Broadcom rose about 6 per cent each. Huang, Nvidia 's fourth-largest shareholder with a 3.61 per cent stake, will also leave the board. Nvidia named former Synopsys CEO and longtime director Harvey Jones as its first board chair. "The Board, Estaff (executive staff) and I recognize that this has been an extraordinarily difficult period," Kress wrote in a memo to employees, adding that the company will host a meeting on Nov 18. Kress was gathering Nvidia 's executive team at its headquarters on Thursday, CNBC reported, adding that Huang had agreed to testify before Congress before Thanksgiving. Huang has hired law firm Paul Weiss, the New York Times reported, citing two people familiar with the matter. It was not clear what the firm had been retained to do, the report said. The company has not commented beyond its statement announcing Huang's resignation. REPLACING HUANG Pressure had been mounting on Huang in recent days after reports said the 63-year-old, who is married, had an affair with a Chinese businesswoman whom US authorities suspect of spying for Beijing. The New York Times also reported Wednesday that Huang had an extramarital affair with a senior company executive who reported to him. While Kress offers investors a familiar hand after 13 years as CFO, analysts have pointed to Buck as a potential longer-term candidate because of Nvidia 's reliance on technical leadership. The veteran engineer helped develop its crucial CUDA software platform and now leads its hyperscale AI products. "The risk is not that Nvidia suddenly loses its technology roadmap ... that roadmap is largely visible for the next several years. The risk is execution. Jensen has been the chief conductor of an extraordinarily complex system," said Michael Feldman, portfolio manager at ClearBridge Investments. "In a world with real bottlenecks, that coordination is a competitive advantage in itself." Investor sentiment toward AI stocks has already been shaky as soaring cash burn and rising debt at traditionally cash-rich tech giants fuel doubts over whether the AI boom will pay off.

TRUMP WEIGHS IN Trump said on Sunday that Huang had "done an amazing job for our country" and that the Nvidia chief had told him he had no idea the Chinese woman he had an affair with was a spy. On Thursday, the US president suggested former Apple CEO Tim Cook should take over as Nvidia 's CEO. US House Speaker Mike Johnson said it was "critically important for right successor to be chosen to replace Huang," noting there was a growing consensus in Congress on limiting exports of semiconductor chips to China. HUANG'S ROCK-STAR STATUS For years, Nvidia was best known to gamers chasing top-tier graphics. But its chips' ability to perform many calculations at once has made them the oil of the AI boom and a strategic prize in the US-China race to dominate the technology. It also made Nvidia the world's most valuable company. That turned Huang into a rock-star CEO, mobbed by fans in Taiwan and South Korea who ask him to sign books, posters and sometimes even their bodies. The scandal preceding Huang's departure unfolded over more than a year, beginning with an October 2025 New York Times report linking him to Alice Huang , a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed, a coveted official Nvidia cloud partner with priority access to its chips. Subsequent reports said US intelligence officials believed Alice Huang was acting on behalf of Chinese intelligence. Beijing has denied Alice Huang is a spy. Washington has also investigated Megaspeed over suspicions it helped China obtain advanced AI chips restricted under US export controls, according to media reports.

Related:

Alice Huang barred from re-entering Singapore; insufficient evidence she committed offences in Megaspeed probe: MHA

What we know about Megaspeed, Singapore-based customer of Nvidia

Separately, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday that the US Justice Department was investigating Alice Huang over whether entities linked to her were involved in efforts to smuggle Super Micro Computer products to China, citing a person familiar with the matter. A spokesperson for the Manhattan US Attorney’s office declined to comment on the Bloomberg report. The office previously charged three people associated with Super Micro, including its co-founder, with helping smuggle at least US$2.5 billion of US AI technology to China in violation of export laws. Super Micro did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Earlier, the Singapore Ministry of Home Affairs said Singapore police had been investigating Super Micro as part of a wider probe into Megaspeed and Alice Huang. The police had reached out to the FBI and the Justice Department for help and had received "limited information or assistance," the ministry said. Earlier this month, Nvidia 's board launched a probe, led by independent directors with outside legal counsel, into whether Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence operation. It also expressed confidence in him at the time. The controversy escalated on Wednesday when the New York Times reported Huang also had an affair with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia 's vice president of healthcare, who reported to him.

Source: Reuters/sz/fs

The number of people who were at home when the 1930-era building collapsed was not immediately known, officials said.

A view of part of the building one day after it collapsed in Brooklyn in New York on Nov 12, 2026. (Photo: AFP/Charly Triballeau)

NEW YORK: Eight people were killed when an apartment building in Brooklyn collapsed into a neighbouring construction site on Wednesday (Nov 11), New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani said. At least 17 people, including three firefighters were injured, Mamdani said on Thursday, as rescue operations continued. The city's fire department earlier told Reuters that four people were in critical condition after the three-storey building in the Flatbush area of Brooklyn collapsed at about 4pm local time on Wednesday and tumbled into the adjoining construction site where excavation work was underway. New York television station WABC-TV reported that at least four survivors were pulled from the wreckage about two to 2.5 hours after the collapse, including a pregnant woman.

Members of the New York City Fire Department and first responders search for victims in the rubble a day after a building collapsed in Brooklyn in New York on Nov 12, 2026. (Photo: AFP/Charly Triballeau)

The number of people who were at home when the 1930-era building collapsed was not immediately known, officials said. They did not say how many workers were on the construction site at the time. City Fire Department Commissioner Lillian Bonsignore said seven children were among those affected by the collapse. She declined to say whether any of the dead were children or adults. UNCLEAR HOW MANY MISSING Mamdani said the city's Department of Buildings and law enforcement officials were investigating the cause of the collapse. A firefighting crew that happened to be in the neighborhood was on the scene within a minute of the collapse and helped pull the first victims from the debris, authorities told reporters at an evening press conference on Wednesday.

Members of the New York City Fire Department and first responders search for victims in the rubble a day after a building collapsed in Brooklyn in New York on Nov 12, 2026. (Photo: AFP/Charly Triballeau)

Local television news footage showed rescue workers with search dogs combing through the building's ruins, removing debris in buckets to look for any signs of people who may have been trapped in voids beneath the debris. John Esposito, the city's fire department chief, said it would take rescue teams several days for the entire site to be "searched for all potential victims", adding, "we do not know how many people are missing overall". About 250 fire and emergency medical services personnel were deployed to the scene, the fire department said.

Source: Reuters/as

Global AI stocks sink as Nvidia CEO's exit deepens sector concerns

As the centrepiece of the AI ecosystem, Nvidia finances infrastructure built around its chips - a strategy that has drawn scrutiny over circular funding and now risks weighing on the sector as its crisis deepens.

The Nvidia Corporation's logo during the CERAWeek energy conference 2026 in Houston, Texas, US, on Mar 24, 2026. (File photo: Reuters/Danielle Villasana)

FAST

Global AI-linked stocks tumbled on Thursday as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned following a deepening scandal around his affairs, upending the chipmaker's leadership and posing fresh risks to a sector already reeling with funding and regulatory concerns. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO as Nvidia looks for a permanent successor, the company said. As the centrepiece of the AI ecosystem, the chipmaker finances infrastructure built around its chips - a strategy that has drawn scrutiny over circular funding and now risks weighing on the sector as its crisis deepens. Nvidia's shares fell 8.2 per cent to a more than 16-month low in early trading and its market value was on track to close below US$4 trillion for the first time since July 2025.

"Nvidia has been called the 'Bank of AI'. If they have to take a step back because of what's going on, will that cut off funding to smaller companies that need it? That's an open question," said Joe Saluzzi, partner and co-head of equity trading at Themis Trading. Nvidia-backed neocloud firm CoreWeave dropped 9.1 per cent after surging more than 27 per cent in the previous session when its earnings ignited a relief rally in AI stocks. Other neocloud stocks, including IREN and Applied Digital, were also trading lower. Nebius dropped 16.2 per cent after the company said its 2026 revenue would come in at the low end of its previous forecast. Nvidia has lost more than US$550 billion in market value since the board announced an investigation on Sunday into Huang's relationship with a businesswoman called Alice Huang, who is alleged to be a Chinese spy. "The interlocking deals that Nvidia has with so much of the industry raises the question into whether that created more stability or more fragility. We're going to find out over the next few weeks as this whole situation unravels," said Steve Sosnick, chief market analyst at Interactive Brokers. Nvidia short sellers have made US$9.6 billion in on-paper profits so far this week, according to data analytics firm ORTEX.

Related:

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid deepening scandal, leaving AI chip giant at crossroads

Jensen Huang scandal could spur tighter US scrutiny of AI cloud providers in Southeast Asia: Analysts

Nvidia, CEO Jensen Huang sued over disclosures related to suspected Chinese spy

AI SELLOFF CONTINUES AFTER BRIEF RESPITE Chipmakers, widely viewed as one of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom, led the selloff with the Philadelphia chips index sliding 1.3 per cent. Marvell Technology, which Huang called the "next trillion-dollar company" in June, slumped 3.8 per cent. AI hyperscaler Oracle, which is expanding its cloud AI chip deals with Nvidia, shed 2.6 per cent. Memory chipmaker Micron Technology fell 2.5 per cent and data storage firms Sandisk and Western Digital eased 6 per cent and 3.7 per cent. Photonic product makers Lumentum and Coherent and AI server maker Dell eased between 3 per cent and 5.1 per cent. Construction and power-generation equipment maker Caterpillar and power producer Vistra slipped about 0.5 per cent each. Shares of AMD and Broadcom, which also produce AI chips and compete with Nvidia, however, rose 3.7 per cent and 5.6 per cent, respectively, on expectations that the turmoil at Nvidia could create opportunity for rivals. Other hyperscalers including Alphabet, Amazon.com and Microsoft were also up between 0.8 per cent and 2.7 per cent. AI stocks struggled and the Nasdaq entered a technical correction earlier this month after the Democrats swept the midterm elections, including in states opposed to data centres, stoking fears tighter regulation could slow the AI build-out. Tech-heavy stock markets across the globe witnessed jitters. Japan and South Korea closed nearly 0.7 per cent lower. Tech stocks in Europe were also down about 1 per cent. Nvidia trades at about 12 times its 12-month forward earnings estimates, its lowest since November 2012, according to data compiled by LSEG.

Source: Reuters/rk

Nov 12 : AMD plans to make an equity investment in quantum computing company PsiQuantum as part of an expanded partnership to develop the infrastructure required for utility-scale quantum computers, the companies said on Thursday. The deal comes when quantum computing is attracting growing investor interest as companies and governments seek systems capable of solving scientific and commercial problems too complex for conventional computers. Breakthroughs in the technology have fueled optimism around its application in areas spanning drug discovery to financial modeling and cryptography. The Commerce Department had in May announced plans to take minority equity stakes in nine quantum computing companies as part of a $2 billion investment under the CHIPS Act, including a $100 million deal with PsiQuantum.

AMD, which makes chips used in data centers and AI systems, and PsiQuantum will co-design computing infrastructure for quantum systems and develop applications that combine quantum computing with high-performance computing and AI. The companies did not disclose the size of AMD's planned equity investment. Under the partnership, AMD will provide CPUs, GPUs, adaptive computing technology and software, while PsiQuantum will contribute its silicon photonics platform, which integrates traditional computing chip technologies with optical networking technologies that use pulses of light to transmit data. PsiQuantum's drug research technology is already running on AMD hardware and can produce more accurate results than existing methods, the companies said. "The combination of PsiQuantum's workflow with AMD's GPU expertise running large-scale simulation has delivered initial breakthrough results in simulation of covalent inhibitors, a class of molecules relevant in drug discovery for oncology."

Nebius pares back 2026 revenue forecast on capacity delays, shares slump

A view shows detail of racks for data servers, GPUs and CPUs inside the Nebius AI UK data centre in Chertsey, Britain, November 6, 2025. REUTERS/Toby Melville/File Photo

12 Nov 2026 08:16PM (Updated: 13 Nov 2026 12:28AM)

FAST

Nov 12 : AI cloud firm Nebius cut its 2026 revenue forecast after delays in third-party capacity additions, sparking fears of a potential slowdown in the US data-center buildout and sending its shares down 16 per cent amid a broader slump in AI stocks on Thursday. The Amsterdam-based company also raised its annual spending forecast, but said it would increasingly rely on customer prepayments and asset-backed financing rather than fresh capital to fund its expansion. The delays come as AI-linked stocks face pressure on several fronts, including financing concerns around neoclouds such as CoreWeave, uncertainty following the Democrats' US midterm election victory and Jensen Huang's departure as Nvidia CEO. Nebius said some third-party capacity expected to come online this year had been pushed back to the first half of 2027, though the contracts underpinning that capacity remained in place.

"Delays are part of our industry right now. We are not immune...none of that capacity is canceled, some of it has shifted to 2027," Nebius CEO Arkady Volozh said. Certain third-party sites, including New Jersey, were running behind, Volozh said, but added that all of Nebius' own facilities under development were on track or ahead of schedule. "Going forward, most of the next gigawatt we are bringing online will be on our own sites." Nebius expects $12 billion to $13 billion in revenue for 2027 and said it would break even on a pre-tax basis by the end of next year. Rival CoreWeave also said on Tuesday it was targeting profitability on an adjusted basis in the first half of 2028 and raised its 2026 revenue outlook. NEOCLOUDS BUCKLE UNDER NVIDIA SCARE Neoclouds including Nebius and CoreWeave are tied closely to Nvidia and Huang. The chip giant is heavily involved in the financing of both companies, being one of their most prominent backers. Analysts have warned that trouble at Nvidia could also result in volatility in neoclouds. Nebius had lost more than a third of its value last month amid a steep selloff in data-center stocks, as investors raised concerns about neoclouds' capacity to raise funds under tighter market conditions. Both Nebius and CoreWeave have tried to assuage those concerns this week. Nebius raised its 2026 spending forecast to about $27 billion from the prior view of $20 billion to $25 billion, while next year's spending is expected to jump sharply to $40 billion to $45 billion. However, roughly 75 per cent to 85 per cent of the 2027 investments will be covered by prepayments from customers and asset-backed financing through existing contracts with hyperscalers such as Microsoft and Meta. Investors have been worried about AI demand after recent hyperscaler earnings hinted at a slower ramp in data-center spending. "We have no doubt that this capacity will be sold. Clients are looking for capacity already for 2028, and prices for 2027 are going up. We do not see any risk," Nebius CFO Dado Alonso said. Nebius' third-quarter revenue of $981 million beat estimates of $907.5 million. It expects 2026 revenue of $3 billion to $3.2 billion, trimming the higher end from $3.4 billion earlier. Nebius also joined CoreWeave in saying it does not expect any meaningful impact on data-center timelines due to the midterm election results.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 28年米大統領選、民主はオソフ・ブティジェッジ両氏に注目＝調査 - Reuters
item.description: 28年米大統領選、民主はオソフ・ブティジェッジ両氏に注目＝調査 Reuters

item.title: 28年米大統領選、民主はオソフ・ブティジェッジ両氏に注目＝調査
item.description:
Tim Reid Jason Lange
[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Tim Reid　Jason Lange

[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - ロイター／イプソスの最新世論調査によると、２０２８年米大統領選の候補として、共和党はバンス副大統領とルビオ国務長官、民主党はブティジェッジ前運輸長官と上院選に勝利したジョン・オソフ氏が注目を集めている。

４人とも正式には出馬を表明していない。各党の指名争いが始まるのは１年以上先で、新たな候補が浮上したり、有権者の見方が変わったりする余地は十分にある。

調査結果によると、共和党支持者の約４５％がルビオ氏を大統領候補として「非常に優れている」と評価した。バンス氏は４３％だった。民主党支持者では、ブティジェッジ氏とジョージア州選出のオソフ氏が、それぞれ２９％から同じ評価を得た。

調査は全米の成人１７０５人を対象に実施し、９日に終了した。

共和党支持者の間では、トランプ大統領と決別する候補を望むか、路線を継承する候補を望むかで意見が分かれる。一方、民主党支持者も弾劾などでトランプ氏をどこまで強く追及するかで意見が割れている。

過去３回の大統領選でトランプ氏に投票したというフロリダ州の弁護士バーバラ・レズナー氏は、バンス氏よりルビオ氏を支持すると話した。バンス氏は右寄り過ぎる上、大統領に近過ぎるという。「ルビオ氏は職務を果たしてきた。左にも右にも行き過ぎず、常軌を逸したこともしていないので、ほとんどの人の目を引かずに済んでいる」と語った。

２８年の共和党の候補者として、ほかにも十数人の名前が取り沙汰されている。中でもデサンティス・フロリダ州知事の評価が高く、共和党支持者の３２％が非常に良い候補と評価した。トランプ氏の息子トランプ・ジュニア氏や、テキサス州選出のクルーズ上院議員らにも支持者はいるが、批判的な人も多い。

＜オソフ氏とブティジェッジ氏＞

民主党ではオソフ氏が有力候補となっており、２９％が非常に優れていると評価した。ここ数カ月、トランプ氏が腐敗しており、大統領の職にふさわしくないと率直な言葉で批判して注目を集めてきた。

ブティジェッジ氏も民主党支持者の２９％から非常に優れているとの評価を得た。２０年にも大統領選に出馬しており、全国的な知名度はオソフ氏より高い。

民主党支持者の約５人に１人がブティジェッジ氏について聞いたことがないと答えたのに対し、オソフ氏では約３人に１人だった。共和党支持者でバンス氏を知らない人はごく少なかったが、ルビオ氏については約６人に１人が知らないと答えた。ただクリントン元大統領のように、知名度の低い候補が選挙戦で急速に支持を広げた例は多い。

ブティジェッジ氏とオソフ氏は民主党内で穏健派とみられている。他の穏健派では、２４年大統領選でトランプ氏に敗れたハリス前副大統領と、ニューサム・カリフォルニア州知事も、それぞれ民主党支持者の２３％から「非常に優れた候補」と評価され、進歩派の代表格でニューヨーク州選出のオカシオコルテス下院議員の１５％を上回った。

オカシオコルテス氏は中間選挙後、ＣＮＮに対し、トランプ氏の弾劾を選択肢に含めるべきだと述べた。一方、ブティジェッジ氏はニューヨーカー誌に弾劾には「あまり関心がない」と語った。

item.description: スターシールドに障害、速度制限で迎撃に支障＝ゼレンスキー氏 Reuters

item.title: スターシールドに障害、速度制限で迎撃に支障＝ゼレンスキー氏
item.description: [１２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１２日 ロイター] - 米宇宙開発企業スペースＸの軍事向け通信サービス「スターシールド」に、数日前から大きな障害が発生していることをウクライナ軍の部隊が確認した。ゼレンスキー大統領が１２日明らかにした。前線全域とロシアが占領するウクライナの地域に影響が及んでいるという。

メッセージアプリ「テレグラム」への投稿で、システム上の制限により、スターシールドを利用できる速度が時速１６１キロメートル（１００マイル）まで抑えられていると説明した。

ゼレンスキー氏によると、この制限によりウクライナの迎撃機はロシアのジェットエンジン搭載無人機（ドローン）を撃墜できる速度に達せず、既に一部が着弾している。

「ロシアがより多くのウクライナ人を殺害し、ウクライナをより正確に攻撃する手助けになっている」と述べた。制限の理由について米国側に説明を求めているとした。

ウクライナ当局者は１０月中旬、スペースＸが民間向け通信サービス「スターリンク」とスターシールドの速度を突然制限したと明らかにしていた。時速約１６０キロを超えるドローンなどの機器の通信が遮断された。

今回の障害が明らかになったのは、米国の仲介でアブダビで開かれたロシアとウクライナの和平協議が終了した翌日だった。ウクライナ当局者は、協議で障害への言及はなく、誰が制限を決めたのか分からないと述べた。

item.title: Chinese Independent Refiners Snap Up Brazilian Crude as Freight Costs Ease
item.description: Chinese independent refiners have purchased millions of barrels of Brazilian crude oil in recent deals, traders said, as easing freight rates improved the economics of long-haul shipments and buyers rushed to use their annual import quotas before the end of the year. The purchases also …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
Chinese independent refiners have purchased millions of barrels of Brazilian crude oil in recent deals, traders said, as easing freight rates improved the economics of long-haul shipments and buyers rushed to use their annual import quotas before the end of the year.

The purchases also reflect a shift away from Russian crude, as persistently high prices for Russia’s ESPO blend have prompted some Chinese refiners to seek alternative supplies from Brazil and other producers.

Totsa, the trading arm of French energy major TotalEnergies, sold about 1.9 million barrels of Brazil’s Sururu and Sepia crude to Hubei-based Jinao Chemical for arrival in late December, traders said.

The cargoes were priced at premiums of around $20 a barrel to the February ICE Brent contract, they added.

Jinao also purchased 1 million barrels of Iraq’s Basrah Medium crude from trading house Mercuria last week at a premium of about $13 a barrel to February ICE Brent for December delivery.

Separately, Totsa sold around 900,000 barrels of Brazilian Sururu crude to Chinese independent refiner Hualong for late-December arrival at a premium of approximately $16 a barrel to February ICE Brent, traders said.

Another independent refiner, Qicheng, bought about 3 million barrels of Brazilian Tupi and Buzios crude for January arrival at premiums of around $18 a barrel to the March ICE Brent contract.

The cargoes were sold by Chinese state-owned energy companies PetroChina and CNOOC, according to the traders.

The deals represent approximately 5.8 million barrels of Brazilian crude purchased by Chinese independent refiners, alongside Jinao’s 1 million-barrel Iraqi purchase.

Prices for Brazilian and West African crude had previously weakened as a surge in tanker freight rates dampened demand from Asian buyers, making long-distance shipments less competitive.

The subsequent decline in shipping costs has improved the attractiveness of Atlantic Basin crude for Chinese refiners, particularly those looking to secure supplies before their annual import quotas expire.

China’s independent refiners, commonly known as teapots, are major buyers of discounted Russian and Iranian crude but also purchase oil from other producers depending on relative prices, freight costs and the availability of import quotas.

The companies involved typically do not comment on individual commercial transactions.

FAST

PARIS, Nov 12 : France's armed forces ministry said on Thursday it will create an international centre to promote and support the growing use of artificial intelligence in defence, as Europe races to strengthen its military technology capabilities and reduce its reliance on the United States. The ministry is hoping that NATO will recognise the centre, due to open in summer 2027, an official told reporters at a briefing. AI tools have become key to warfare since Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022, helping to speed up battlefield decision-making by processing and interpreting large quantities of data produced by drones, satellites and other sensors. However, Europe is reliant on US-based companies like Palantir for much of its AI-enabled military software.  The ministry has not yet finalised funding or international members for the centre. It has invited representatives from other countries to a conference next week to outline its plans for the initiative.

Source: Reuters

item.description:
Andrew Silver
[上海 １２日 ロイター] - 米医薬品大手イーライ・リリーは１２日、肥満症治療薬「Ｇ...

item.content:encoded:
米イーライ・リリーの経口ＧＬＰ－１肥満症薬、中国で初承認 11/12 19:49 配信

イーライ・リリーのビル、カリフォルニア州サンディエゴで2025年撮影 REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） Andrew Silver

[上海 １２日 ロイター] - 米医薬品大手イーライ・リリーは１２日、肥満症治療薬「ＧＬＰ－１受容体作動薬」の経口薬について、中国で初めて承認を取得した。競合するノボノルディスクに先行した。

イーライ・リリーは承認された「オルフォルグリプロン」の中国での価格や発売時期に関するコメント要請に応じていない。

デンマークのノボノルディスクも中国で「ウゴービ」の経口版の販売承認を申請している。

中国でこれまで利用できたＧＬＰ－１の肥満症治療薬は注射薬だけだった。

ＪＰモルガンの中国ヘルスケア調査責任者のヤン・ホアン氏は、中国の減量向けＧＬＰ－１薬の年間売上高が、現在の推定３０億─４０億元から今後５─７年で３００億元（４５億ドル）に達する可能性があると予測している。

Bomb alert temporarily halts trains at Calais station in France, causing Eurostar delays

The alert came amid a broader wave of bomb threats and hoaxes reported in France and other European countries in recent months, targeting flights, schools and, in some cases, media organisations.

A Eurostar train is seen waiting to cross from the Channel to England, at the Calais-Frethun train station in northern France, on Sep 2, 2015. (File photo: AFP/Denis Charlet)

FAST

PARIS: A bomb alert temporarily disrupted train services at Calais-Fréthun station in northern France on Thursday (Nov 12) morning, affecting both domestic and international rail travel. Train services resumed later on Thursday morning after the gendarmerie authorised their restart, national rail operator SNCF said. The national gendarmerie did not immediately respond to an emailed request for comment. International high-speed rail operator Eurostar said some services between London and Paris had been affected by the disruption, as trains traveling on the route pass through Calais-Fréthun. The incident caused delays to services to and from London, the company said. The alert came amid a broader wave of bomb threats and hoaxes reported in France and other European countries in recent months, targeting flights, schools and, in some cases, media organisations. It was not immediately clear whether Thursday's alert was linked to any of the previous threats.

Yantoultra Ngui Nikita Maria Jino
[１２日 ロイター] - グーグルの親会社アルファ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アルファベットの香港・Ｓドル建て債、38億ドル発行　需要旺盛で増額 11/12 19:37 配信

グーグルのロゴ、ロンドンで2025年6月撮影 REUTERS/Carlos Jasso/File Photo（ロイター） Yantoultra Ngui　Nikita Maria Jino

[１２日 ロイター] - グーグルの親会社アルファベットが初めて発行する香港ドル建て債とシンガポールドル建て債で、当初目標を上回る約３８億ドルを調達する。旺盛な需要を受けて発行額を増やした。ロイターが１２日に確認した起債条件書で分かった。

両通貨建て債への応募額は合計７０億ドルを超えた。計７本立てで、香港ドル建て債を１６０億香港ドル（２０億ドル）、シンガポールドル建て債を２２億８０００万シンガポールドル（１８億ドル）発行する。応募額には発行を取りまとめる銀行からの注文も含まれる。

ロイターが１１日に報じたところによると、アルファベットは両通貨建て債で計３０億ドルの調達を目指していた。最低で８０億香港ドル、１５億シンガポールドルの発行を検討していた。

起債条件書によると、調達資金は債務返済の可能性を含ね一般事業目的に充てる。

３本立ての香港ドル建て債への応募額は３２５億香港ドル（４１億ドル）を超え、１２日の早い段階の２４０億香港ドル超から増加した。このうち１３２億３０００万香港ドルは共同主幹事からの注文だった。

４本立てのシンガポールドル建て債への応募額は４０億シンガポールドル（３１億ドル）を超え、２５億シンガポールドル超から増加した。このうち９億６５００万シンガポールドルは共同主幹事からの注文だった。

アルファベットは香港ドル建て債の発行利回りは、２年債７５億香港ドルは４．３５％、５年債７０億香港ドルは４．７０％、１０年債１５億香港ドルは５．２０％とした。当初目安の４．６０％、５．００％、５．５０％から引き下げた。

シンガポールドル建て債発行利回りは、２年債３億７０００万シンガポールドルが２．５０％、５年債９億シンガポールドルが３．００％、１０年債３億３０００万シンガポールドルが３．４０％、３０年債６億８０００万シンガポールドルが３．８０％。当初の目安２．７５％、３．２５％、３．６５％、４．００％から引き下げた。

決済予定は１１月１９日、 社債はムーディーズから「Ａａ２」、Ｓ＆Ｐから「ＡＡプラス」の格付けを取得する見通し。

item.description: An Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis killed six people, including a doctor, and wounded at least a dozen, according to Gaza's Health Ministry.
item.content:encoded:
Home / World News / Israeli airstrike on Gaza hospital kills 6, injures 20; sparks tensions

Israeli airstrike on Gaza hospital kills 6, injures 20; sparks tensions An Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis killed six people, including a doctor, and wounded at least a dozen, according to Gaza's Health Ministry.

The damage inside Nasser Hospital after an Israeli airstrike in southern Gaza on Thursday | Photo: Reuters

Reuters 1 min read Last Updated : Nov 12 2026 | 11:56 PM IST

Listen to This Article

An Israeli airstrike targeting the Nasser Hospital in southern Gaza killed six people and wounded at least a dozen more, Gaza's Health Ministry said.   The strike was carried out early Thursday, according to the Israeli military, which said it struck "a senior Hamas terrorist" and other militants, without providing evidence.   The Gaza Health Ministry said the strike hit the hospital's surgery department and that a doctor was among the dead. An Associated Press journalist at the scene said that parts of the building's second floor were destroyed.   Nasser Hospital in the city of Khan Younis is one of the few functioning medical facilities left in Gaza, whose healthcare infrastructure has been decimated by the war. Israel accuses Hamas and its allies of using hospitals as cover for military activity.

Israeli forces have previously targeted Nasser Hospital. In 2025, the military killed five journalists — including AP contributor Mariam Dagga — when it struck a gathering point for local reporters at the complex.

item.title: Trump says US does not need Iran deal, directs Vance to focus on domestic corruption
item.description: Read more about Trump says US does not need Iran deal, directs Vance to focus on domestic corruption on Devdiscourse ...
item.content:encoded:
Trump says US does not need Iran deal, directs Vance to focus on domestic corruption Reuters | Updated: 12-11-2026 23:55 IST | Created: 12-11-2026 23:55 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

President Donald Trump said on Thursday the US does not need a deal with Iran and directed Vice President JD Vance, who has played a role in efforts to resolve the war, to focus "his complete and total attention" on alleged crime and corruption in Democratic-run cities and states. Trump's directive came a day after the Wall Street Journal reported that Vance was considering face-to-face peace talks with a hard-line Iranian security official and a week after the vice president blamed the costly war with Iran for Republicans' midterm elections drubbing. "We don’t need a deal with Iran. Those days have long since passed. We’ve got their money, Hundreds of Billions of Dollars, and we’ve got their Strait!" Trump wrote on social media, referring to the Strait of Hormuz. Trump had suggested in recent weeks that Iran would be more willing to strike a deal in the eight-month conflict after the US elections, but his administration this week signaled it believes its blockade and economic sanctions against Iran are working, meaning neither a military escalation nor diplomacy is needed. The US military is imposing a blockade on Iranian ports, while attempting to secure safe passage for international shipping through the vital Strait of Hormuz. Iran's military said on Thursday four oil tankers were hit by explosions after they ignored Iranian warnings. Vance's office did not immediately respond to a request for comment. VANCE HAD LED IRAN DIPLOMACY Vance, long seen as skeptical of the war the US and Israel launched on Iran in February, led talks with Iranian officials in Pakistan in April that produced a June memorandum of understanding that paused the war but broke down within weeks. Iranian state media said late last month Tehran had received a letter from Vance seeking renewed talks with Washington. Trump said he had not directed his vice president to make the outreach. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Tuesday after talks with US allies in Paris that Iran's demands for a potential deal were "absurd," citing its demand for reparations for the war, and said Trump would not sign a bad deal. The Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday that Vance was considering meeting with a senior Iranian security official, a move that would have put Vance at the center of peace negotiations. Reuters has not confirmed the potential talks. Vance, who is viewed as a leading contender for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, distanced himself from the war last week after Republicans' midterm election rout by Democrats. The vice president blamed the costs of the Iran war in part for the party's losses. He also said an earlier recommendation to end the war was "sound advice." Trump responded to Vance's position by defending the war as necessary to stop Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon. In his social media post, Trump said he had asked Vance to focus instead on a domestic issue the president previously put in his portfolio: leading an effort targeting alleged fraud in Democratic-run cities and states throughout the US. "Our Budget could be quickly BALANCED with the correction of this large-scale criminal activity. CORRUPTION is in the Democrat Leadership’s blood!" Trump wrote on Thursday.

(This story has not been edited by Devdiscourse staff and is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

item.title: Stan Wong’s Top Picks for Nov. 12, 2026
item.description: The outlook for global equities remains constructive despite recent market volatility. The U.S. economy has maintained steady growth, and corporate earnings continue to grow. Persistent inflation and ...
item.content:encoded:
Stan Wong, Portfolio Manager, Scotia Wealth Management Focus: North American Large Caps & ETFs

Top Picks: Alphabet , iShares Semiconductor ETF , Vanguard Industrials ETF MARKET OUTLOOK: The outlook for global equities remains constructive despite recent market volatility. The U.S. economy has maintained steady growth, and corporate earnings continue to grow. Persistent inflation and elevated bond yields remain risks, especially for stocks whose valuations leave little room for earnings disappointments. Technology has seen some of the sharpest swings. In the recent market decline, the Nasdaq-100 fell about 15 per cent from peak to trough, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell about 40 per cent. The selling pressure extended to companies supplying power and equipment for data centers as investors reassessed the regulatory outlook following the U.S. midterm elections. The selloff may also have been intensified by hedge funds exiting crowded and, in some cases, leveraged positions tied to artificial intelligence. The market reaction appears to have overstated the long-term risk to AI investment. Permitting delays and power constraints remain legitimate near-term challenges, as they can raise costs and postpone projects. However, global demand for computing capacity continues to grow, several states within the U.S. are competing to attract data center projects, and strategic competition with China gives the U.S. another reason to keep building. For investors, the question is whether share prices have fallen further than the earnings outlook warrants. Order backlogs, margins and cash flow can help gauge whether project delays are starting to weigh on earnings prospects. At The Stan Wong Group, we continue to favour high-quality large-cap businesses with resilient cash flows, durable competitive advantages and strong growth prospects. We remain disciplined about what we pay for that growth. As always, investment decisions should be made within the context of each investor’s broader total wealth plan. How to set BNN Bloomberg as your preferred source on Google Market-moving news, fast:  Get the BNN Bloomberg App now Sign up for the Market Call Top Picks newsletter at  bnnbloomberg.ca/newsletters TOP PICKS: Stan Wong’s Top Picks: Alphabet, iShares Semiconductor ETF & Vanguard Industrials ETF Stan Wong, portfolio manager at Scotia Wealth Management, shares his top stock picks to watch in the market.

Alphabet (GOOGL NASD) Alphabet’s recent drawdown of more than 30 per cent has created an unusual opportunity to invest in one of the world’s highest-quality technology companies at a notably lower valuation. The shares now trade at approximately 18 times forward earnings, below their 10-year average of about 20.7 times. Alphabet is much more than a search company. Its businesses span Search, YouTube, Google Cloud, subscriptions and Waymo, giving it several powerful ways to monetize artificial intelligence. The latest results showed that AI is strengthening rather than disrupting the core business. Revenue increased 25 per cent to US$127.6 billion, while Search revenue grew 12 per cent and query growth reached its fastest pace in five years. Gemini has reached one billion users, demonstrating enormous scale in generative AI. Google Cloud is becoming a much larger earnings engine. Revenue more than doubled to US$30.7 billion, while operating income more than tripled to US$11.1 billion. Cloud backlog reached US$561 billion, with more than half expected to become revenue within two years, providing strong visibility into future growth. Meeting that demand requires substantial investment. Alphabet expects 2026 capital expenditures of US$195 billion to US$205 billion, primarily for AI and cloud infrastructure. This is pressuring near-term free cash flow, but approximately US$265 billion in cash and marketable securities gives Alphabet considerable capacity to fund the buildout. When the shares last crossed the 30 per cent drawdown threshold in September 2022, they gained 36.8 per cent over the following 12 months. Technically, the shares appear to be stabilizing, and a recovery toward the 200-day moving average would confirm improving momentum. iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX NASD) The iShares Semiconductor ETF provides diversified exposure to 30 leading semiconductor companies and seeks to track the investment results of the NYSE Semiconductor Index. Major holdings include AMD, Nvidia, Broadcom, Micron and Intel. Its management fee is 0.33 per cent. Semiconductors are the essential building blocks of artificial intelligence, cloud computing, smartphones, automobiles, industrial automation and defence. AI-driven demand is broadening beyond graphics processors into memory, networking chips, power-management semiconductors and advanced packaging. Global AI-server revenue is projected to increase 64 per cent in 2026 to US$462 billion, with AI servers expected to represent 77 per cent of total server revenue. SOXX provides exposure across this expanding value chain without requiring investors to identify one eventual winner. The recent selloff has dramatically improved valuations. The NYSE Semiconductor Index currently trades at approximately 15 times forward earnings, nearly half the peak multiple reached during 2025 and back to levels last seen in 2022. SOXX recently experienced a drawdown of 40 per cent. Bloomberg analysis of previous SOXX drawdowns of at least 40 per cent over the past 25 years shows an average 12-month forward return of 25.3 per cent, with positive returns 75 per cent of the time. While history does not guarantee the same result, severe semiconductor corrections have often created attractive long-term buying opportunities. From a technical perspective, the correction has reset momentum and created a more attractive entry point. SOXX has begun to stabilize and is working back toward its 200-day moving average. A recovery above that level would provide further confirmation of improving momentum. Compelling valuations and a powerful growth outlook reinforce the long-term opportunity. Vanguard Industrials ETF (VIS NYSE) The Vanguard Industrials ETF provides exposure to nearly 400 U.S. industrial companies for a low expense ratio of 0.09 per cent. Major holdings include Caterpillar, GE Aerospace, RTX, Eaton and Deere. This diversified portfolio captures several important long-term investment themes. The U.S. industrial cycle is gaining momentum. Core capital-goods orders increased 14.1 per cent year over year, signalling stronger business investment. Manufacturing reshoring, infrastructure renewal, aerospace and defence spending, electrification and grid modernization are creating sustained demand for machinery, transportation, engineering and electrical equipment. Artificial intelligence provides another powerful growth engine. Data center construction spending is forecast to increase 33 per cent in 2026 and a further 25 per cent in 2027. The benefits extend beyond technology companies because these facilities require electrical equipment, cooling systems, automation, construction machinery and reliable power. Many VIS holdings provide the physical infrastructure required to build and operate the AI economy. The ETF combines established industrial leaders with companies positioned at the core of the power and data center buildout, reducing reliance on any one company or theme. It also provides exposure to a recovery in traditional capital spending beyond AI. From a technical perspective, VIS recently experienced a drawdown of almost 15 per cent following a strong multi-year advance. The pullback has improved the risk-reward profile, and the ETF is now recovering toward its 200-day moving average. A sustained move above that level would strengthen the technical outlook. Improving capital spending, durable secular growth drivers and broad diversification reinforce our positive view.
